hero.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL flagship brand illustration for OpenPali, an independent public-evidence project about the Pacific Palisades rebuild. Brand concept: 'A place with footnotes.' This must have a distinctive authored world and story, not a letter logo or generic tech object. Main scene: a beautifully hand-built miniature coastal FIELD OFFICE made entirely from folded archival paper and cobalt-blue ink. A large open accordion-fold atlas lies across a white work surface. Its raised die-cut white paper contours become a gently rolling coastal bluff and canyon, with a cobalt ocean curling around its lower edge in three elegant paper-cut ribbons. On the atlas are a few thin translucent tracing-paper sheets, precise blue contour lines, small blank source slips held by a cobalt binder clip, and one very fine blue pencil. A SMALL ORIGINAL PAPER PELICAN is working at the right edge of the atlas, lifting a corner of the transparent tracing sheet with its long cobalt beak. Bird character: folded white archival-paper body, crisp cobalt-blue wing, long subtly curved beak and pouch, tiny dark-blue attentive dot eye, slim blue legs; restrained, intelligent, curious, not a baby mascot. The pelican is a supporting actor about one sixth of the scene height, not the central hero. The character's paper silhouette should be memorable and reproducible. The scene tells a story of looking closely, tracing, checking, assembling knowledge. No houses or buildings; no fire, ruins, reconstruction progress, real parcels or data visualization. No letters P, logos, typography, text or numbers. Composition: full landscape 3:2 art asset, scene centered toward the right, plenty of calm negative white space around the whole object, complete object unclipped, low orthographic three-quarter camera, fine tactile paper fibers, luminous translucent vellum, softly cast true shadows, blue edges. White paper, saturated cobalt #1557FF, pale powder-blue, tiny deep-navy details ONLY. Art direction: premium contemporary editorial illustration meets meticulous stop-motion paper sculpture; warm human craftsmanship, deliberately irregular folded corners, beautifully staged asymmetry. No plastic, no glass cube, no glossy floating monogram, no round blob, no generic SaaS gradient. White background #FFFFFF. Extremely considered lighting and detail, visually striking but calm.
